xna-type.name: GraphicsDeviceCapabilities.VertexShaderCaps
xna-type.summary: Represents vertex shader version 2_0 extended capabilities.

property.name: DynamicFlowControlDepth
property.summary: Gets a value specifying the depth of the dynamic flow control instruction nesting.

property.name: NumberTemps
property.summary: Gets a value specifying the number of temporary registers supported.

property.name: StaticFlowControlDepth
property.summary: Gets a value specifying the depth of nesting of the loop - vs/rep - vs and call - vs/callnz bool - vs instructions.

property.name: SupportsPredication
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether instruction predication is supported.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

overload.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

field.name: MaxDynamicFlowControlDepth
field.summary: Specifies the maximum level of nesting of dynamic flow control instructions (break - vs, break_comp - vs, breakp - vs, if_comp - vs, if_comp - vs, if pred - vs).

field.name: MaxNumberTemps
field.summary: Specifies the maximum number of temporary registers supported.

field.name: MaxStaticFlowControlDepth
field.summary: Specifies the maximum depth of nesting of the loop - vs/rep - vs and call - vs/callnz bool - vs instructions.

field.name: MinDynamicFlowControlDepth
field.summary: Specifies the minimum level of nesting of dynamic flow control instructions (break - vs, break_comp - vs, breakp - vs, if_comp - vs, if_comp - vs, if pred - vs).

field.name: MinNumberTemps
field.summary: Specifies the minimum number of temporary registers supported.

field.name: MinStaticFlowControlDepth
field.summary: Specifies the minimum depth of nesting of the loop - vs/rep - vs and call - vs/callnz bool - vs instructions.
